newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: CRICKET-INJURED IRANI UNDERGOES BONE SCAN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INJURED IRANI UNDERGOES BONE SCAN.

text.p: England all-rounder Ronnie Irani was taken to Harare on Monday for a bone scan on his injured back.
Irani, 25, played in Sunday's opening one-day international against Zimbabwe, which England lost, despite feeling discomfort when bowling.
England could send for a replacement, probably Yorkshire's Craig White, if the scan showed a problem, team sources said.
Irani was not expected to play in the first test against Zimbabwe which starts on Wednesday.
